name: King's Stone Holdings Group Limited
summary: King's Stone Holdings Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides construction services for the public and private sectors in Hong Kong and he People's Republic of China. The company operates through Construction Services and Intelligent Storage Business segments. It provides traditional formwork services using timber and plywood; system formwork using aluminum and steel; and ancillary works, such as concrete works and reinforcement works. The company also undertakes other construction works, comprising plastering and A&A works; and other miscellaneous works, such as reinforcement bar fixing and concrete placing.
